name: pr-open
description: Open any GitHub PR in its local clone and hand off to the GitHub Pull Requests extension for native review + inline commenting.

prOpen.searchRoots.markdownDescription: Absolute directories to scan for local clones (e.g. `~/dev`). A PR for `owner/repo` resolves to `<root>/<repo>`. Required; each entry must be an existing directory. `~` is expanded to your home directory.

prOpen.cloneRoot.markdownDescription: Which of `#prOpen.searchRoots#` to clone missing repos into. If unset, the first search root is used.

prOpen.review.model.markdownDescription: Model passed to `claude --model` when generating a guided review (e.g. `claude-opus-4-8`). If unset, defaults to `sonnet`. Must be a non-empty string when set.

prOpen.ask.model.markdownDescription: Model passed to `claude --model` when answering a question about lines of the diff (e.g. `claude-opus-4-8`). If unset, defaults to `sonnet`. Must be a non-empty string when set.

prOpen.address.model.markdownDescription: Model passed to `claude --model` when addressing the checked-out PR's review comments (e.g. `claude-opus-4-8`). If unset, defaults to `sonnet`. Must be a non-empty string when set.

prOpen.adversarialReview.model.markdownDescription: Model passed to `claude --model` when running an adversarial review of the PR (e.g. `claude-opus-5`). If unset, defaults to `fable`. Must be a non-empty string when set.

prOpen.adversarialReview.standardsSectio.markdownDescription: Which section of your `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` the adversarial review judges a design finding against. Code that breaks one of its rules is reportable; the section changes nothing about what counts as a correctness or style finding. When your file has neither this section nor `#prOpen.adversarialReview.instructionsSection#`, the whole file serves both jobs. Set to an empty string to always append the whole file.

prOpen.adversarialReview.instructionsSec.markdownDescription: Which section of your `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` is appended to the adversarial review's prompt, for the voice of a finding. When no section with this name exists, the review takes whatever `#prOpen.adversarialReview.standardsSection#` did not already claim, so the two never restate each other. Set to an empty string to always append the whole file.

prOpen.review.includeBusinessContext.markdownDescription: Show a two-sentence summary of the concrete problem and resolution above the guided review.

prOpen.logTimings.markdownDescription: Log a per-phase breakdown of each action (PR page, Diff, Checkout) to the `PR Open` output channel, alongside the total that is always logged. Costs process-wide async context tracking in the extension host, so leave it unset unless you are measuring.

prOpen.checkForUpdatesOnStartup.markdownDescription: Check GitHub for a newer PR Open release on startup (at most once a day) and offer a one-click install when one is available. Turn off to only check via `PR Open: Check for Updates`.
